summary: Pluri Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement of securities to an institutional investor. The company agreed to sell 1,200,000 common shares at $1.50 each and pre-funded warrants for 1,028,940 shares at $1.49999 each, plus common warrants to purchase up to 2,228,940 shares at $1.65, exercisable after six months. Expected gross proceeds approximately $2.98 million, used for corporate development. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
